description: Add photos to ONE product, after the photos it already has: public https image links (images, each with an optional caption), files the person attached in ChatGPT (files — ChatGPT fills it), or links returned by create_image_upload for files on the agent's own machine. Obriym downloads every image and stores its OWN COPY in the workspace's storage — the link may be temporary and nothing hotlinks to it. Limits: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB each (a bigger file is refused — there is no resize), at most 10 photos per product. All or nothing: if any link fails, or the total would exceed 10, nothing is stored and the reason is returned. Saves through the product form's own operation (version check, audit, channel updates). Not idempotent: repeating the call adds the photos again. Returns the product's full photo list { url, alt } — the first is the main photo. Use get_product first to see the current photos and update_product_images to reorder, caption or remove them. The result echoes the workspace.

files.description: Image files the person attached in ChatGPT. ChatGPT fills this field itself; any other client leaves it out and passes image links instead (or uploads files with create_image_upload).

download_url.description: Temporary link ChatGPT gives to the attached file.

file_id.description: ChatGPT's id of the attached file.

images.description: Photos to ADD after the product's current ones, in order. The product may hold at most 10 photos in total; a request that would exceed it is refused and nothing is stored.

alt.description: Caption (alt text) of the photo, up to 200 characters. Empty or omitted: the storefront falls back to the product name. Do not invent a description of what you cannot see.

url.description: A public https image link (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 2 MB). Obriym downloads it and stores its own copy in the workspace, so the link may be temporary.

productId.description: The product id from search_products or get_product.

name: add_product_images
title: Add product images
